certifications_training_url.name: certifications_training_url
certifications_training_url.value: "certifications"."training_url" IS NULL OR (length("certifications"."training_url") <= 500 AND ("certifications"."training_url" LIKE 'https://%' OR "certifications"."training_url" LIKE 'http://%'))

grants_revoke_reason_length.name: grants_revoke_reason_length
grants_revoke_reason_length.value: "grants"."revoke_reason" IS NULL OR length("grants"."revoke_reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 300
